newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells LTNs to drain liquidity - traders.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells LTNs to drain liquidity - traders.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank early Wednesday sold National Treasury Letters (LTNs) due in February 1 1997 during two auctions to drain an excess of liquidity in the open market, traders said.
Financial volume was not disclosed, they added.
The LTNs were sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.532 percent a month, in line with market expectations.
Traders estimate there was an injection of over 1.5 billion reais in the market this morning, which led the Central Bank to sell securities to have liquidity under control.
They could not, however, identify who was injecting the large amount of reais into the market.
